text:
kari: Planning to ship 1.8.5 (patch) tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. Main question: pin the stable channel to this patch or allow automatic rollforward? cc @tom @anya

 tom: I'd vote pin for patch-only fixes. Avoid surprises for downstream consumers. :eyes:

 anya: +1 for pin unless it's docs-only. What exactly is in the patch?

 kari: It's a hotfix for KV-cache double-eviction under specific interleaved requests. No API changes, just behavior fix. deploy-bot run shows patch-only. Options: tag 1.8.5 (pin) or publish as non-pinned with buildmeta (rollforward).

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary on staging passed. Suggested action: tag as 1.8.5 and open hotpatch branch. Recommend running rollback smoke tests pre-promote.

 leif: If we pin, ops will need the rollback playbook in the release notes. If we allow rollforward, we should monitor latency + eviction metrics closely. Tradeoffs: customer stability vs simpler release flow.

 tom: Pin wins for me — keeps deterministic cache behavior for clients. Proposal: pin + 30m backout window after full rollout.

 anya: Also propose tagging convention: use plain semver for the release (1.8.5) and use an explicit backport suffix for backports/reverts (1.8.5-backport.1) rather than opaque buildmeta. Easier to read in dashboards.

 kari: Agreed. Decision: pin stable channel to 1.8.5, create 1.8.5-backport branch for any needed backports, include rollback playbook in notes. I'll kick off the deploy at 02:00 and ping SRE. :thumbsup:

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout started at 02:00:10 UTC — canary on pool-a. Monitoring endpoints: /dash/latency, /dash/evictions.

 leif: If canary is clean, promote to 50% at 02:15 and full at 02:30. @sre-oncall please ack. :shipit:

 sre-oncall: ack — monitoring live, will escalate if latency > 10% or evictions spike.

 kari: Thanks all. I'll update release notes with the pin rationale and include the explicit revert command: `git tag -d 1.8.5 && git push origin :refs/tags/1.8.5 && deploybot rollback --tag 1.8.5`. Keeping conversation here for audit.
